scenes.self: After months of training, I cross the marathon finish line and my friends lift me onto their shoulders.
scenes.other: After months of training, she crosses the marathon finish line and her friends lift her onto their shoulders.

scenes.self: I open the front door, and my missing dog bounds up the steps, wagging his tail and licking my hands.
scenes.other: He opens the front door, and his missing dog bounds up the steps, wagging his tail and licking his hands.

scenes.self: At graduation, I walk across the stage, take my diploma, and my family stands up in the front row.
scenes.other: At graduation, she walks across the stage, takes her diploma, and her family stands up in the front row.

scenes.self: After a long hike, I sit at a wooden table and eat warm bread with melted cheese and tomato soup.
scenes.other: After a long hike, he sits at a wooden table and eats warm bread with melted cheese and tomato soup.

scenes.self: My toddler lets go of the couch, takes three wobbling steps, and lands in my open arms.
scenes.other: Her toddler lets go of the couch, takes three wobbling steps, and lands in her open arms.

scenes.self: At the airport arrivals gate, my sister runs past the barrier and wraps both arms around my neck.
scenes.other: At the airport arrivals gate, his sister runs past the barrier and wraps both arms around his neck.

scenes.self: I pull a bright orange carrot from the soil, brush off the dirt, and drop it into a full basket.
scenes.other: She pulls a bright orange carrot from the soil, brushes off the dirt, and drops it into a full basket.

scenes.self: The landlord hands me the keys, and I stand alone in the empty living room with sunlight on the floor.
scenes.other: The landlord hands him the keys, and he stands alone in the empty living room with sunlight on the floor.

scenes.self: My daughter and I press star shapes into cookie dough, and the kitchen smells of cinnamon and butter.
scenes.other: Her daughter and she press star shapes into cookie dough, and the kitchen smells of cinnamon and butter.

scenes.self: The band returns for an encore, and I sing every word with thousands of strangers under purple lights.
scenes.other: The band returns for an encore, and he sings every word with thousands of strangers under purple lights.

scenes.self: I slide the final puzzle piece into place and step back to see the whole mountain landscape.
scenes.other: She slides the final puzzle piece into place and steps back to see the whole mountain landscape.

scenes.self: I dive under a clear wave, surface beside my brother, and we float on our backs in the salty water.
scenes.other: He dives under a clear wave, surfaces beside his brother, and they float on their backs in the salty water.

scenes.self: I open the box of freshly printed books and run my finger down the cover with my name on it.
scenes.other: She opens the box of freshly printed books and runs her finger down the cover with her name on it.

scenes.self: My boss shakes my hand and leads me to a corner office with a window overlooking the city.
scenes.other: His boss shakes his hand and leads him to a corner office with a window overlooking the city.

scenes.self: I stand at the altar as my partner says vows, and our friends throw rice as we leave.
scenes.other: She stands at the altar as her partner says vows, and their friends throw rice as they leave.

scenes.self: I hang my painting on the gallery wall, and visitors stop to photograph it with their phones.
scenes.other: He hangs his painting on the gallery wall, and visitors stop to photograph it with their phones.

scenes.self: I pull a struggling swimmer from the lake, and the parents on the shore wrap towels around their son.
scenes.other: She pulls a struggling swimmer from the lake, and the parents on the shore wrap towels around their son.

scenes.self: I roll a huge snowball across the yard and place it on top of two smaller ones.

scenes.self: The line jerks; I reel in a silver fish and hold it up for my grandfather to see.
scenes.other: The line jerks; she reels in a silver fish and holds it up for her grandfather to see.

scenes.self: I spread a blanket under an oak tree, and my friends arrive with baskets of strawberries and lemonade.
scenes.other: He spreads a blanket under an oak tree, and his friends arrive with baskets of strawberries and lemonade.

scenes.other: He scans three calendars, finds a slot, and creates an invitation that lands in every inbox at once.
